  \\\\_____________________________________________________________________\\\\
   ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Listed here are all of the weapons in the game, in order of character
recruited, followed by weakest to strongest.


.——————————.
|   Yuri   |
|——————————'——————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.
|                     |   A-Lv. 0   |   A-Lv. 1   |   A-Lv. 2   |   A-Lv. 3   |
|  Weapon             | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk |
|=====================|=============|=============|=============|=============|
|  Leather Gloves     |    0 /   0  |    1 /   1  |    2 /   2  |    3 /   3  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Cow-hide with steel-plated knuckles.                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Leather Gloves                                         |
|                      Leather gloves for punching. Damages enemy while       |
|                      providing protection. Ideal for fighters.              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Knuckle Blade      |   11 /   9  |   13 /  10  |   15 /  12  |   17 /  14  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Made of a hard black steel and used for punching.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Knuckle Blade                                          |
|                      This handheld weapon has sharp blades affixed to it    |
|                      allowing for slashing as well. It is made of a         |
|                      powerful black steel and is easily carried.            |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Steel Claw         |   22 /  18  |   25 /  20  |   28 /  23  |   31 /  26  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Lethal weapon designed to pierce armor.                |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Steel Claw                                             |
|                      A favored weapon among Eastern assassins. Its          |
|                      unusually long blade and frightening appearance make   |
|                      it a weapon to be feared.                              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Hand Needle        |   30 /  18  |   34 /  20  |   38 /  23  |   42 /  26  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Ninja stabbing weapon with double sides.               |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Hand Needle                                            |
|                      An ancient weapon, the middle finger passes through a  |
|                      ring and it is clutched in the fist. When mastered,    |
|                      it can be used to block an enemy's sword.              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Brass Knuckles     |   61 /  54  |   68 /  60  |   75 /  66  |   82 /  73  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Well-crafted metal knuckles, useful for brawlers.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Brass Knuckles                                         |
|                      The dream of any rough-and-tumble brawler, they are    |
|                      made of hand-forged brass and can raise the user's     |
|                      punching power enormously.                             |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Silver Talon       |   75 /  67  |   83 /  74  |   92 /  82  |  100 /  90  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy silver claws that are easy to use.                |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Silver Talon                                           |
|                      Silver claws gripped between the fingers. Easy to use  |
|                      and accurate due to their light weight. An excellent   |
|                      weapon for the powerful fighter-type. Very valuable.   |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Silver Wolf Fang   |   85 /  72  |   94 /  80  |  104 /  88  |  113 /  96  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Made from the enchanted fang of a wolf king.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Silver Wolf Fang                                       |
|                      A weapon created from the fang of the wolf king,       |
|                      Vadelg. It is said to hold great power but no details  |
|                      are known because it has never been found.             |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Nightbird Claw     |   89 /  85  |   98 /  94  |  108 / 104  |  118 / 113  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Used by an ancient war god in magic-sealing.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Nightbird Claw                                         |
|                      This weapon was said to have been used in ancient      |
|                      days by the god of war and that its wielder can        |
|                      summon the power of Ashura. Its true origin is a       |
|                      mystery.                                               |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'


.———————————.
|   Alice   |
|———————————'—————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.
|                     |   A-Lv. 0   |   A-Lv. 1   |   A-Lv. 2   |   A-Lv. 3   |
|  Weapon             | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk |
|=====================|=============|=============|=============|=============|
|  Small Bible        |    0 /   0  |    1 /   1  |    2 /   2  |    3 /   3  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Written on sheepskin, it holds great power.            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Small Bible                                            |
|                      Sheepskin engraved bible containing the written word   |
|                      of God. Its holy power may be discovered only by the   |
|                      true believer.                                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  ShootingStarTome   |    8 /  13  |    9 /  15  |   11 /  17  |   13 /  19  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Superb manuscript about a fabled continent.            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Tome of the Shooting Star                              |
|                      Antique book about a fabled continent that sank into   |
|                      the sea beneath a falling star. Lovingly transcribed   |
|                      from the original and very valuable.                   |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Tome of the Moon   |   17 /  23  |   19 /  26  |   22 /  29  |   25 /  32  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Black velvet book with details about magic arts.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Tome of the Moon                                       |
|                      Ancient book of Magic encased in a black velvet        |
|                      cover. It is written with elegant calligraphy and      |
|                      embossed in gold leaf.                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Tome of the Sun    |   30 /  39  |   34 /  43  |   38 /  48  |   42 /  53  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Book of anti-magic to counter Tome of the Moon.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Tome of the Sun                                        |
|                      Ancient book of curse removal and magic-blocking.      |
|                      Extremely difficult to read, but legends say if done   |
|                      so with a pure heart, it can redeem an entire nation.  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Ever-Bible         |   53 /  64  |   59 /  71  |   65 /  78  |   71 /  86  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy book embedded with shining blue crystals.         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Ever-Bible                                             |
|                      Ancient, holy book embedded with shining blue          |
|                      crystals. Necessary for performing an exorcism ritual  |
|                      on a possessed woman.                                  |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Grand Bible        |   65 /  77  |   72 /  85  |   80 /  94  |   87 / 103  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy book of prophesy with great spiritual power.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Grand Bible                                            |
|                      Only the greatest of holy leaders my possess this      |
|                      book of prophesy. The book itself carries great        |
|                      mystical power.                                        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  HolyBook-Martyrs   |   72 /  84  |   80 /  93  |   88 / 102  |   96 / 112  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Ancient book stained with the blood of martyrs.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Holy Book of the Martyrs                               |
|                      Holy book stained with the blood of martyrs who        |
|                      labored for countless years in service against the     |
|                      forces of evil. Strong spiritual power.                |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Holy Book-Flesh    |   85 /  89  |   94 /  98  |  104 / 108  |  113 / 118  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy book made from the flesh of a saint.              |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Holy Book of Flesh                                     |
|                      After the death of Rafaelo, his flesh was used to      |
|                      make this book. To a good person it can bring          |
|                      blessings, but to others it may open the very doors    |
|                      of hell.                                               |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'


.—————————————.
|   Zhuzhen   |
|—————————————'———————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.
|                     |   A-Lv. 0   |   A-Lv. 1   |   A-Lv. 2   |   A-Lv. 3   |
|  Weapon             | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk |
|=====================|=============|=============|=============|=============|
|  Oak Staff          |    0 /   0  |    0 /   1  |    1 /   2  |    2 /   3  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Made from ancient oak, it enhances magic powers.       |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Oak Staff                                              |
|                      Staff made from the limb of an ancient oak. It raises  |
|                      a magic wielder's abilities and is a necessary step    |
|                      on the way to becoming an Adept in the Taoist Arts.    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Hexagonal Staff    |    8 /  11  |    9 /  13  |   11 /  15  |   13 /  17  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Heavy metal staff capable of great destruction.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Hexagonal Staff                                        |
|                      Metal rod. Heavy and destructive, it is perfect for    |
|                      the adventuring clergyman. The accumulated experience  |
|                      of many a holy man lies within the staff itself.       |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Pilgrim's Staff    |   17 /  24  |   19 /  27  |   22 /  31  |   24 /  34  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Carved from a sacred tree. Light and strong.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Pilgrim's Staff                                        |
|                      Staff carved from a sacred tree. Given its light       |
|                      weight and strength, it is an ideal weapon for older   |
|                      adventurers.                                           |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Hermit's Staff     |   31 /  39  |   35 /  44  |   39 /  49  |   43 /  54  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Staff for outdoor adventurers. A powerful weapon.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Hermit's Staff                                         |
|                      Staff of a hermit who explored the wild regions of     |
|                      the continent. Its scarlet color is said to be the     |
|                      hermit's own blood. A valuable and powerful weapon.    |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Oracle's Staff     |   52 /  61  |   58 /  68  |   64 /  75  |   70 /  82  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Staff of the Oracle with special attack powers.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Oracle's Staff                                         |
|                      This staff can only be held by the most dedicated of   |
|                      Oracles. It is said to bring calamity upon those       |
|                      unworthy to wield it. Tremendous attack power.         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Four God's Staff   |   67 /  77  |   74 /  85  |   82 /  94  |   89 / 103  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy Staff. Few can master its powers.                 |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Four Gods' Staff                                       |
|                      Staff blessed by the spirit of Mitama. In the hands    |
|                      of a master, the staff itself is said to become        |
|                      sentient. Very few can tap into its true power.        |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Sage Staff         |   75 /  83  |   83 /  92  |   91 / 101  |  100 / 111  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Contains the soul of an actual Taoist Adept.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Sage Staff                                             |
|                      Before his death, a powerful Taoist Adept transferred  |
|                      his soul into this staff. In the hands of a fellow     |
|                      Adept, it is a weapon of extreme power.                |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Holy Peak Staff    |   86 /  88  |   95 /  97  |  105 / 107  |  114 / 117  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Holy staff. Grants wielder incalculable power.         |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Holy Peak Staff                                        |
|                      Legendary holy staff. It is claimed that whoever       |
|                      wields it will have the power to control Heaven and    |
|                      Earth.                                                 |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'


.———————————————.
|   Margarete   |
|———————————————'—————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.
|                     |   A-Lv. 0   |   A-Lv. 1   |   A-Lv. 2   |   A-Lv. 3   |
|  Weapon             | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk | P-Atk/S-Atk |
|=====================|=============|=============|=============|=============|
|  Mini-Mauser        |    0 /   0  |    2 /   2  |    4 /   4  |    6 /   6  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Lightweight machine gun. Perfect for spies.            |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Mini-Mauser                                            |
|                      Easy to carry, semi-automatic pistol. Not very         |
|                      powerful or accurate but a good weapon in the right    |
|                      hands.                                                 |
|_____________________________________________________________________________||¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Type 94 Pistol     |    2 /  -2  |    4 /  -1  |    6 /   1  |    8 /   3  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): 8 mm automatic; Can cause Confusion                    |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Type 94 Pistol                                         |
|                      8 millimeter radius, 8-shot automatic. Extremely well  |
|                      balanced and easy to use, but must be used with        |
|                      caution due to its light trigger. Also causes          |
|                      Confusion.                                             |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Nanbu Pistol       |   11 /   8  |   14 /  10  |   17 /  13  |   20 /  16  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Improved version of the Type 94. Very accurate.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Nanbu Pistol                                           |
|                      Automatic handgun with a unique rounded trigger        |
|                      guard. Improved version of the Type 94 with small      |
|                      recoil and very high accuracy.                         |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Zeruel             |   48 /  47  |   54 /  53  |   61 /  60  |   68 /  67  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Mid-sized machinegun with unmatched balance.           |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Zeruel                                                 |
|                      The most perfectly balanced of all 9 mm portable       |
|                      machineguns. Extremely reliable with a low             |
|                      malfunction rate.                                      |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Draze              |   55 /  47  |   62 /  53  |   70 /  60  |   77 /  67  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): New model of popular machinegun. High attack.          |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Draze                                                  |
|                      The machinegun, manufactured by a well-respected       |
|                      gunmaker, is unrivalled in terms of its lightweight    |
|                      design. Very expensive, but well worth the price.      |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  12 Gauge           |   60 /  60  |   68 /  68  |   76 /  76  |   84 /  84  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Shotgun with massive stopping power.                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): 12 Gauge                                               |
|                      Sawed-off, 12 gauge riot gun with unsurpassed          |
|                      stopping power. Its intimidating appearance and        |
|                      powerful report strike fear into enemies.              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  Mauser Prototype   |   70 /  70  |   79 /  79  |   88 /  88  |   97 /  97  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Prototype with improved firing speed and power.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): Mauser Prototype                                       |
|                      Rapid firing, machinegun prototype. Uses 9 mm          |
|                      Parabellum bullets. Its unique wooden stock can be     |
|                      fixed to the ground as a base. Heavy but incredibly    |
|                      powerful.                                              |
|_____________________________________________________________________________|
|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯|
|  10 Gauge           |   79 /  75  |   88 /  84  |   98 /  94  |  108 / 103  |
|—————————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————|
|  Description (Menu): Rifle well-known for its excellent performance.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Description (Info): 10 Gauge                                               |
